summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Concord Medical Services Holdings Ltd reporting that its subsidiary, Concord Healthcare Group Co., Ltd., completed the issue of HK$68 million in 2% convertible bonds due 2027, placed by Haitong International Securities and subscribed by Dragon Merit Holdings. No price per share, premium, or board recommendation is mentioned, and there is no change in control or special-situation event. This is an ordinary financing disclosure with no special-situations content; therefore it does not warrant classification under any listed special-situation category.
